sources.description: Anthropic went public on November 19th, 2026. | Photo: Getty Images Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades.

sources.name: Phys.org
sources.title: Anthropic researcher says Claude solved math's greatest riddle
sources.description: A mathematician at AI company Anthropic said Friday that he had used the firm's Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years.
